verdict.rationale: No evidence that Omnara offers data residency/region selection for stored data; the product is self-hostable (open source, Apache 2.0), which could theoretically satisfy residency needs, but there's no documented feature letting cloud/hosted users choose a storage region. Community comments even raise unresolved concerns about data being visible to a 3rd party and lack of E2E encryption, further indicating no formal residency control exists.
